title: Zesty Bouncy Jamaican Mint Ssam-Wrap
description: A vibrant and refreshing Jamaican-inspired ssam-wrap, perfect for a date night dinner or a romantic evening.

ingredients.name: ssam-wrap
ingredients.notes: preferably made from lettuce or collard green leaves

ingredients.name: grilled chicken breast
ingredients.notes: seasoned with jerk seasoning and grilled

instructions: Begin by preheating a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Season the chicken breast with jerk seasoning and grill for 5-6 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, prepare the mint sauce by combining coconut cream, honey, ginger, garlic, curry powder, and cayenne pepper in a blender.
Blend the mixture until smooth and creamy.
Slice the grilled chicken breast into thin strips.
To assemble the ssam-wraps, lay a ssam-wrap leaf flat on a work surface.
Place a few slices of grilled chicken breast in the center of the leaf.
Add a spoonful of mint sauce on top of the chicken.
Fold the bottom half of the leaf up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrap to form a snug package.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
